name: use-file-download
title: useFileDownload
description: Hook for downloading private files via signed URLs with loading state and abort support.

docs.lead: A React hook that downloads private files by fetching a signed URL from your API, then streaming the file as a blob to trigger a browser download with a controlled filename. Includes abort support, loading state, and error handling.

examples.title: Download Button
examples.description: Trigger a file download from a button click using a storage key.

examples.title: File List with Active Key Tracking
examples.description: Show which file is currently downloading in a list using activeKey.

api.name: useFileDownload Options
api.description: Configuration options passed to the hook.

props.name: endpoint
props.description: API endpoint path that accepts POST { key } and returns { data: { url } } with a signed download URL.

props.name: baseUrl
props.description: Base URL prepended to the endpoint.

props.name: headers
props.description: Function returning headers for the signed-URL request (e.g. auth tokens, workspace keys). Called on each download.

api.name: useFileDownload Return Value
api.description: The object returned by the hook.

props.name: download
props.description: Initiate a download for the given storage key. Optionally specify the filename for the saved file.

props.name: isDownloading
props.description: True while a download is in progress.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: The storage key currently being downloaded, or null when idle. Useful for showing per-item loading states in a list.

props.name: error
props.description: The last download error, or null. Reset on each new download call.
